layer_b_repeated_phrases._strata: multiword = phrases of two or more tokens. single_proper = one token seen capitalized mid-sentence somewhere, so a name or a piece of realia - the stratum Cathedral's first-mention canon was about. single_common = one token never capitalized, ordinary vocabulary, reported so its noise is visible rather than folded into the headline.
layer_b_repeated_phrases._what: Repeated non-glossary source phrases inside different sentences. No target-side alignment exists, so consistency is a proxy: some substring of length ratio*len(phrase) present in every target of the group.
